$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs (manager/rules/SEO.md). No actorId yet: the first CI deploy creates the actor, private, and its ID goes here (Phase B).
seoTitle: Welcome to the Jungle Jobs Scraper - France & Europe
seoDescription: Search every Welcome to the Jungle job in France, the UK, the US and Europe by title, city, contract and pay. Newest first, with salary and remote policy.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 512 MB, as the family, until Apify runs measure 512 MB, 1 GB and 2 GB (Phase B). Local runs on 2026-11-10 peaked under 200 MB.

pricing.$comment: PLACEHOLDER prices, not applied (apply false): Phase B measures the cost on Apify and sets each tier by the owner rule of 2026-11-10 (markup over cost: FREE 100%, BRONZE 95%, SILVER 90%, GOLD 85%, PLATINUM and DIAMOND 80%; the run start covers the fixed cost of a run per GB). README.md and llms.txt carry the same numbers.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, offices, remote policy, contract, pay, experience band, company size, industry, summary, key missions, posting date and link. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description, experience wanted and recruitment process as text and HTML, skills, tools, start date, the company's website and apply link.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).
